framing_measurement.subject_bbox_definition: topmost visible hair pixel through lowest visible footwear pixel

asset_pipeline.input: two or more licensed source inspirations

asset_pipeline.output: original fashion mood card with neutral test subject

asset_pipeline.input: approved plate, light, camera, palette and negatives
locked approved look plus one preset pack

source_authorities.use: street scale, calm vanishing point and stone material cues only
secondary facade rhythm and neutral European material vocabulary only

standard_presets.environment: A newly designed quiet European stone street with one calm vanishing point, no recognizable landmark and geometry distinct from either source.

lighting.key: cool open-sky fill with a narrow warm side and back edge from low morning sun
lighting.fill: natural cool sky fill

source_authorities.use: warm facade-light behavior, stone palette and restrained perspective only; storefronts, people, brands and exact architecture are excluded
secondary stone palette and restrained architectural texture only

standard_presets.environment: An original restrained stone arcade and city lane with simplified facades and no landmark, sign or copied source geometry.

lighting.key: low warm side and back sunlight with long coherent shadows and clean highlight roll-off
lighting.fill: cool open-sky ambient fill

source_authorities.use: soft studio falloff and warm background relationship only
full-body studio scale and seamless-background behavior only

standard_presets.environment: An original empty dusty-peach seamless cyclorama with a clean floor-to-wall transition and no props.

lighting.key: large softbox thirty-five to forty-five degrees from camera with delicate sculpting and smooth falloff
lighting.fill: weak frontal fill plus subtle floor bounce

source_authorities.use: clean white studio depth and full-body composition only
soft fill level and restrained beauty finish only

standard_presets.environment: An original optical-white seamless studio with a newly designed geometric window-lattice light pattern on the wall and floor.

lighting.key: hard warm morning light through a geometric honeycomb lattice, coherent on wall, floor and part of the face
lighting.fill: cool skylight fill preserving eye and item detail

source_authorities.use: dark studio separation, negative space and tonal restraint only
dramatic face modelling and full-body shadow readability only

standard_presets.environment: An original dark-taupe seamless studio with gentle depth and no theatre, smoke or visible equipment.

lighting.key: warm elevated key at roughly forty-five degrees forming a small cheek triangle on the shadow side
lighting.fill: controlled three-to-one to five-to-one key-fill relationship with a very weak rim

source_authorities.use: edge-light separation and restrained dramatic pose scale only
charcoal tonal field and quiet negative space only

standard_presets.environment: An original graphite curved studio wall and floor with subtle texture, empty of props and visible equipment.

lighting.key: cool early-morning side and top ambience with a narrow pale-gold rim or coherent window shaft

source_authorities.use: high-window scale, quiet gallery proportion and daylight direction only
secondary wall and floor material restraint only

standard_presets.environment: A newly designed off-white gallery with plaster, travertine or light oak and one large window, distinct from source architecture.

lighting.time_or_setup: early morning through one large window
lighting.key: long soft side light with a gentle warm edge and physically coherent contact shadow
lighting.fill: clean cool ambient room fill

source_authorities.use: room depth and window rhythm without industrial grime or copied geometry
secondary minimalist scale and clean window-light logic only

standard_presets.environment: An original controlled plaster, wood and stone loft with broad clean surfaces, no recognizable furniture and no copied source layout.

lighting.key: low golden beams with long coherent geometry and soft highlight roll-off

source_authorities.use: path rhythm, restrained planting and low-light atmosphere only
architecture-to-grass balance and clean structural scale only

standard_presets.environment: An original pale-limestone terrace with restrained dry grasses and minimal sage greenery, not a park and not a tourist location.

lighting.key: cool morning sky with a narrow warm side edge and soft natural shadow transition
lighting.fill: open cool sky fill

source_authorities.use: concrete and ornamental-grass relationship without road or underpass cues
secondary dry-grass palette and low warm-light behavior only

standard_presets.environment: An original clean concrete and stone platform with controlled ornamental dry grasses and no highway, bridge or copied structure.

lighting.key: low golden side and back light defining the body and grasses without destructive flare

source_authorities.use: warm amber backlight behavior, wet cobblestone reflections and narrow street depth only
secondary wet surface reflection behavior and atmospheric haze only

standard_presets.environment: An original narrow European stone alley with weathered facades and cobblestone pavement, no recognizable landmark, sign or copied geometry.

lighting.key: low warm amber backlight streaming between buildings casting long dramatic shadows on cobblestones

source_authorities.use: neoclassical scale, arched window rhythm and crumbling plaster texture only
light shaft behavior through tall windows and dusty atmosphere only

lighting.key: warm amber light shafts cutting diagonally through dusty air from tall arched windows
lighting.fill: deep shadow with minimal cool ambient fill

source_authorities.use: dappled forest light behavior, moss texture and path depth only
canopy bokeh and atmospheric mist behavior only

standard_presets.environment: An original mystical foggy forest path with dense tree canopy, moss-covered ground, atmospheric mist, and no recognizable trail or park.

lighting.key: warm amber light rays piercing through dense tree canopy catching fog particles

source_authorities.use: exposed brick texture, steel beam rhythm and factory window scale only

lighting.key: one dramatic warm light shaft from large factory window across dusty concrete floor

source_authorities.use: rooftop elevation, skyline bokeh depth and sunset horizon color only
concrete parapet texture and cool evening tone only

lighting.key: low warm golden sun at horizon creating long shadows across concrete, warm rim on subject

source_authorities.use: wet urban asphalt reflection behavior and moody night atmosphere only
neon color reflection on wet surfaces and volumetric fog behavior only

lighting.key: diffused magenta and teal neon glow reflecting off wet asphalt with volumetric fog
lighting.fill: deep ambient darkness with colored light spill on subject edges

hard_negatives: color cast on items destroying original color

source_authorities.use: soft filtered light through fabric and tall window proportion only

lighting.time_or_setup: golden hour diffused through sheer curtains

source_authorities.use: pitch black studio void and directional spotlight behavior only
pure black seamless backdrop absorption and rim-light separation only

source_authorities.use: raking side light and warm-cool color contrast only
dark studio separation and textured wall behavior only

source_authorities.use: glass facade geometry, clean lines and sunset reflection behavior only

source_authorities.use: sandy coastline scale, horizon line and wet sand reflections only

qa_gates.pass_condition: approved white master SHA-256 exactly matches the requested look
external subjects have zero authority over identity, body, hair or outfit
no copied person, text, brand, landmark or source-specific architecture is present
observable identity remains the approved person without substitution
all approved visible items, colors, construction, logos and text remain faithful
environment, time, palette and prohibited-object checklist match the selected preset
key direction, fill, subject integration and contact shadow are physically coherent
full-body framing, margins, verticals and anatomy satisfy the preset locks
released asset has hash, exact prompt, model version, source ledger and approval
